summary: Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, then read NOTES.md, the page files and the UI guidelines. An auto-compaction happened while it was reading. After that, without being asked, it started the visual companion with start-server.sh, gave me a localhost URL, and wrote filter-placement.html with three wireframes (A: inline filter bar, B: popover with tags, C: inline bar plus a failed-sign-ins shortcut). It said the task was bounded and that the design would stay in chat with no spec file. I picked A. It asked its non-visual follow-ups in the terminal, laid out the design in chat, waited for my approval, then said "Status: approved" and started on implementation. It wrote no spec or plan file.
reasoning: All eight criteria are backed by the session log, the files on disk and the screen text. The agent decided on its own that the filter layout was a visual question, even though I never asked to see anything. It opened the companion only at the point that layout question came up, kept the task bounded with no spec or plan file, asked for approval before writing code, and started implementation once I approved.

observations.description: Auto-compaction happened twice (session log has two compact_boundary entries: once while it read the guidelines before the companion opened, once just after I approved). The companion still opened correctly after the first compaction (compaction at log line 64, start-server.sh at line 90). The screen showed 'Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)'.

The agent noted that .hyperpowers/ is not in .gitignore, so the mockup files show up as untracked in git status. It flagged this itself and didn't commit them. The companion could add the gitignore entry automatically or prompt for it.
The agent warned that the companion 'uses a lot of tokens, so tell me if you'd rather stay in the terminal'. That's a reasonable heads-up and didn't block anything.
It started the server with --open, which tries to open a browser on its own. This may be unexpected in headless environments.
I interrupted with Escape and /exit right after implementation started, so the implementation was not finished or checked. The scenario ends at the point where implementation begins.

criteria.evidence: Screen: "Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill". This was its first tool call in the session log (jq tool_use list: first entry "Skill: hyperpowers:brainstorming").

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened: start-server.sh run, localhost URL given, HTML screen written
criteria.evidence: Log tool call: "Bash: .../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir "$PWD" --open". Screen showed the URL "http://localhost:62087/?key=6253...". The file .hyperpowers/brainstorm/85591-1790948540/content/filter-placement.html contains three h3 headings: "Inline filter bar above the table", "Filter button, popover, and active-filter tags", "Inline bar with a \"Failed sign-ins only\" shortcut".

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time; non-visual questions not routed through browser
criteria.evidence: Before start-server.sh, the log shows only reading calls (NOTES.md, page files, guidelines, visual-companion.md). The companion was introduced with "The real open question is where the filter controls go, so I've drawn the options in a browser tab". The non-visual follow-ups came through terminal AskUserQuestion prompts: "Which filters should the inline bar include?", tokens, existing CSS, no-JS. The browser was only updated to waiting.html ("Placement A chosen. Continuing in terminal...").

Screen: "I'm treating this as bounded: the page and its rendering code already exist. That means a short design here in chat, with no spec file." The full design was then presented in chat, ending with "Does this design look right? I'll start once you say yes."
`find coding-agent-workdir/docs -path '*specs*' -o -path '*plans*'` returned nothing. `ls docs` shows only ui-guidelines. git status shows only `?? .hyperpowers/`.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: `grep -o '"skill":"[^"]*"'` on the session log returns only "hyperpowers:brainstorming". The specs/plans find returned nothing.

criteria.criterion: Approval of layout requested before implementation code
criteria.evidence: It asked "Have a look and tell me what you think" and later "Does this design look right? I'll start once you say yes." No Edit/Write to public/ appears in the log before my approval.
After I replied "Yes, looks right. Go ahead.", the screen showed "Status: approved. I'm re-reading the guideline files to get the exact token values before writing anything."
